method: Full Valid proof scripts instrumented by an outer tactic using IO.monoNanosNow immediately before/after evalTactic of the entire original by-body. Includes caller unfolding/cbv, provePuddleValid (builder normalization, constructor, support, root and structural proofs, semantic normalization), every continuation tactic, and final symbolic proof composition. Excludes imports, helper declarations, timer logging and final enclosing theorem kernel checking. Whole-file wall times are recorded separately and include startup, imports, helper declarations, all proofs and final kernel checking. Dependencies already built; no module C-object/executable rebuilds. Fresh Lean process per file/version/repetition, run sequentially; alternate before/after order and reverse file order on the second repetition. Elab.async false in both instrumented snapshots. Every measured proof file compiled successfully.
before: All 110 use original ordinary provePuddleValid: ordinary support simp and ordinary semantic simp. Sources from the original baseline snapshots used in the earlier whole-file comparison.
after: Current workspace: all 110 use provePuddleValid sym, with symbolic support and symbolic semantic normalization. Existing native metadata preprocessing and the adapted constant-rotate continuations remain included.

reproduction.snapshot_transform:
from pathlib import Path
import json,re
root=Path('/Users/fehr/prog/veir')
work=Path('/private/tmp/veir-puddle-overall-bench')
old=Path('/private/tmp/veir-sym-validity-bench')
files=json.loads((old/'files.json').read_text())
helper='''set_option Elab.async false
open Lean Elab Tactic in
elab "timePuddleProof" label:str "=>" body:tacticSeq : tactic => do
  let t0 ← IO.monoNanosNow
  evalTactic body
  let t1 ← IO.monoNanosNow
  logInfo m!"PUDDLE_PROOF|{label.getString}|{t1-t0}"
'''
rx=re.compile(r'(?m)^[ \t]*(?:private )?theorem\s+(\w+)\s*:\s*(?:Veir\.)?Puddle\.CTree\.Pattern\.Valid\s+(.*?)\s*:= by\n',re.S|re.M)
manifest=[]
for version in ['before','after']:
    dest=work/version
    dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for filename in files:
        source=(old/'before'/filename).read_text() if version=='before' else (root/'Veir/Passes/InstructionSelection'/filename).read_text()
        matches=list(rx.finditer(source))
        for m in reversed(matches):
            body_start=m.end()
            lines=source[body_start:].splitlines(keepends=True)
            body=[]
            for line in lines:
                if line.strip() and len(line)-len(line.lstrip())<2: break
                body.append(line)
            body_end=body_start+sum(len(l) for l in body)
            key=filename+':'+m.group(1)
            replacement=f'  timePuddleProof "{key}" =>\n'+''.join('  '+line if line.strip() else line for line in body)
            source=source[:body_start]+replacement+source[body_end:]
            manifest.append(dict(version=version,file=filename,theorem=m.group(1),pattern_argument=m.group(2)))
        source=source.replace('module\n','module\npublic meta import Lean\n',1)
        lines=source.splitlines(keepends=True)
        last_import=max(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r'(public (meta )?)?import ',l))
        lines.insert(last_import+1,'\n'+helper+'\n')
        (dest/filename).write_text(''.join(lines))
(work/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
(work/'files.json').write_text(json.dumps(files,indent=2)+'\n')
assert len(manifest)==220
print('Instrumented',len(manifest),'complete Valid proof scripts.')
reproduction.runner:
from pathlib import Path
import json,re,subprocess,time
root=Path('/Users/fehr/prog/veir')
work=Path('/private/tmp/veir-puddle-overall-bench')
files=json.loads((work/'files.json').read_text())
manifest=json.loads((work/'manifest.json').read_text())
rows=[]
processes=[]
for trial in range(3):
    order=files if trial%2==0 else list(reversed(files))
    versions=['before','after'] if trial%2==0 else ['after','before']
    for filename in order:
        for version in versions:
            p=work/version/filename
            t0=time.perf_counter()
            proc=subprocess.run(['lake','env','lean','--tstack=400000',str(p)],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True)
            elapsed=time.perf_counter()-t0
            (work/f'{version}_{trial}_{filename}.log').write_text(proc.stdout+proc.stderr)
            data=re.findall(r'PUDDLE_PROOF\|([^|\n]+)\|(\d+)',proc.stdout)
            expected=[r for r in manifest if r['file']==filename and r['version']==version]
            if proc.returncode or len(data)!=len(expected):
                print(proc.stdout+proc.stderr,flush=True)
                raise SystemExit(f'{version} {filename}: return {proc.returncode}, expected {len(expected)} rows, got {len(data)}')
            rows.extend(dict(trial=trial,version=version,file=filename,theorem=key.split(':',1)[1],ns=int(ns)) for key,ns in data)
            processes.append(dict(trial=trial,version=version,file=filename,seconds=elapsed,returncode=proc.returncode))
            (work/'raw.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(proofs=rows,processes=processes),indent=2)+'\n')
            print(f'trial {trial+1} {version:6s} {filename}: {len(data)} complete proofs, sum {sum(int(x[1]) for x in data)/1e9:.3f}s (file {elapsed:.1f}s)',flush=True)
print('COMPLETE',len(rows),flush=True)
